in_marathi.name: Ritwika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ritwika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ritwika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rit' meaning knowledge and 'Wika' meaning goddess. It is believed that the goddess Ritwika imparts wisdom and knowledge to her devotees.
